sourcePolicy: Fineli supplies available carbohydrate quantities only. GI evidence is stored as individual, traceable records: STRONG records must be published, glucose-scale, ISO 26642-confirmed and preparation-matched; SUPPLEMENTARY records are for internal comparison and never produce a public GL. ISO 26642 says only tested foods receive GI values, advises against testing foods with <10 g glycaemic carbohydrate per usual serving, and does not define a component-weighted sum as a measured GI of a heterogeneous recipe. This pilot's formula is an ingredient-sum estimate, not a measurement of the prepared meal. Do not copy complete source tables or substitute unmatched foods/preparations.
